title: Powerful Antimicrobial Tonic
description: A powerful antimicrobial tonic that may help destroy intestinal parasites, dissolve stubborn mucus, reduce inflammation, and strengthen your immune defense naturally.
steps: Boil one tablespoon of whole cloves, three crushed garlic cloves, half a teaspoon of turmeric, and a pinch of black pepper in two cups of water for 10 minutes.
Then strain and stir in one teaspoon of raw honey.
notes:
Chinese will never mix cloves with garlic unless they want to kill parasites and melt stubborn mucus naturally.
